name: Resemble AI
description: Resemble AI is a voice cloning and AI speech generation platform that creates hyper-realistic synthetic voices from audio samples. It supports real-time streaming TTS, custom voice cloning from as little as 3 seconds of audio, and a localization API for dubbing content into multiple languages. Used for IVR systems, audiobooks, game characters, and personalized voice experiences.

useCases.task: Clone a specific person's voice for text-to-speech
Generate realistic AI voiceover for videos or podcasts
Build voice-enabled IVR or customer service bots with custom voices
Stream TTS audio in real-time for low-latency voice applications
Localize/dub video content into multiple languages

setupSteps: Go to Account > API Key to generate your API token
Create a voice (or clone one by uploading audio samples)
Note your project UUID from the project settings

pricing.freeTier: No persistent free tier; trial credits provided on signup
pricing.costPer: $0.006/second for standard TTS; real-time streaming has different pricing; voice cloning: included with API access

rateLimits.limit: Varies by plan; async clip generation has no strict rate limit; streaming is concurrent-connection limited
rateLimits.notes: Async clip generation (non-streaming) is queued and can handle high throughput. Real-time streaming connections are limited per account tier. Contact sales for high-volume pricing.
rateLimits.retryStrategy: Implement exponential backoff for 429 and 503 responses. For async clip generation, poll the clip status endpoint rather than holding the connection open.

codeExamples.title: Generate a speech clip from text (async)
codeExamples.notes: Use callback_uri instead of polling for production — pass a webhook URL and Resemble will POST to it when the clip is ready. For real-time use cases, use the streaming API instead of async clips.

gotchas: Voice cloning quality depends heavily on the quality and diversity of the training audio. Clean audio with minimal background noise and varied intonation (not monotone reading) produces significantly better results than low-quality samples.

Resemble's async clip generation can take 10-60 seconds for longer texts. For user-facing real-time applications, use the streaming WebSocket API instead, which delivers audio chunks as they're generated with much lower latency.

The `body` field for clip generation accepts plain text but also supports SSML for controlling pronunciation, pauses, and emphasis. However, not all SSML tags are supported — test carefully before relying on SSML in production.
Generated audio URLs are temporary and expire. Download and store the audio to your own storage (e.g., S3, Cloudinary) immediately after generation if you need persistent access.

reliability.notes: Resemble AI is production-grade and used by enterprise customers. Async generation is highly reliable; real-time streaming is more sensitive to network conditions.

qualityJustification: Best-in-class for voice cloning realism, especially from short audio samples. The API is well-designed and the Node SDK is usable. The main limitations are the pay-as-you-go pricing (no free tier) and the need to manage clip polling or webhooks for async generation. A solid choice for voice-heavy applications; compare with ElevenLabs for non-cloning TTS use cases.
bestFor: Custom voice cloning and high-realism AI speech generation for IVR, audiobooks, and branded voice experiences
